sanskrit_verse:
य एनम् एवं विन्दन्ति य वारण्यकम् आश्रिताः ।
उपासते द्विजाः सत्यं श्रद्धया परया युताः ॥१९२॥
transliteration: ya enam evaṃ vindanti ya vāraṇyakam āśritāḥ | upāsate dvijāḥ satyaṃ śraddhayā parayā yutāḥ ||192||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who thus know the Truth, and those who dwell in the forest, devoted to renunciation—these twice-born ones worship with supreme faith.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from direct realization, not institutional position
Causation is aligned with consciousness-depth, not external action
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by inner commitment, not social role
Restoration logic operates through alignment with Satya, not punitive correction
Consciousness alignment supersedes ritualistic or societal performance
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor realizes Truth → THEN authority is self-established
IF individual dwells in renunciation → THEN worship authenticity is presumed
IF dvija acts with parama śraddhā → THEN legal capacity is maximal
IF conduct aligns with satyam → THEN no corrective enforcement required
IF consciousness-depth exceeds social-role → THEN role-based law is overridden
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, precedence based on realized understanding shall outweigh procedural formalities. Where a party demonstrates dwelling in renunciative truth and worships with full śraddhā, their testimony carries ultimate pramāṇa weight. Legal capacity is assessed by depth of consciousness, not procedural standing.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established through inner realization, not external evidence. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential unfoldment of consciousness, not causal chain of action. Responsibility is proportional to the clarity of satya-darśana, not volume of activity. Non-punitive reality is upheld because dharma is self-restoring when consciousness awakens.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Realization Verification Process: Confirm satya-darśana through experiential markers
Śraddhā Assessment Protocol: Evaluate depth of faith-commitment through sustained alignment
Renunciate Integration Framework: Support transition from isolation to societal harmony
Consciousness Witnessing Mechanism: Deploy realized beings to validate truth claims
Dharma Reestablishment Sequence: Align disputants with satyam through guided reflection
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This verse establishes that realization, renunciation, and śraddhā constitute the true basis of legal authority. Justice is restored through consciousness awakening, not punitive measures. Reality is non-punitive; consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
